## Design

### 2026-10-16 – ![Screenshot 2026-10-16 142630](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0CkUxdN5HZgh0MbVudWobYQ7CUJYEUjI/51809adb8cdc0b7dcf36f04a43c4764bf79a000e579bea736ca2eacc39bbaf96.png)

**3h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 142630](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0CkUxdN5HZgh0MbVudWobYQ7CUJYEUjI/51809adb8cdc0b7dcf36f04a43c4764bf79a000e579bea736ca2eacc39bbaf96.png)
First sketch of my design based on various cards I measured. Still trying to figure out what I'm going to use to protect the cards while they're in the wallet. Maybe felt strips, but I need something that will provide enough friction to hold them in place.

![IMG_4134](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0CkUxdN5HZgh0MbVudWobYQ7CUJYEUjI/9ff4e921ee29546aaf3033fd35c4f653b3f8b82ba747c47887824c9737cde603.jpg)
Printing my first prototype design.

![IMG_4135](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0CkUxdN5HZgh0MbVudWobYQ7CUJYEUjI/ea43957ae498cfd5a220b228ae83186b6d6b5c9a4c8011ad702256c75a5d02e4.jpg)
Here's my first design printed out, it didn't print very well and there's some flaws I'd like to fix.

The finger slot doesn't go deep enough to push the cards out far enough. The holes for the screws were too close to the edges. It's not satisfying to use.

After much struggle with the "card swing" design, I have decided to follow the idea of Occam's Razor and go with a simpler solution. The whole moving part system has just led to frustration and unpredictability. Hopefully this design will print well and work how I expect.
